title: Western
story: Saddle up for a sunny day on the frontier.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A tan felt cowboy hat with a wide curled brim that rolls up at both sides, a tall crown with a center crease, and a band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: tan, dark brown, red band

cards.name: Boots
cards.subject: A pair of brown leather cowboy boots with tall shafts, pointed toes, raised heels and a stitched star pattern on each shaft, standing side by side.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, dark brown, light orange stitching

cards.name: Sheriff Star
cards.subject: A symmetrical silver sheriff badge: a six-pointed star with a small ball on each point, a gold ring in the center, and a small pin clasp at the back edge.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, gold center ring

cards.name: Saloon Doors
cards.subject: A pair of wooden swinging saloon doors with slatted louvers, each hung on a hinge to a wooden frame, reaching waist to head height, set in a plank storefront entrance with a small step.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, tan, small red painted trim
cards.surface_or_setting: the entrance of a wooden saloon front on a plank porch

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A single tall green saguaro cactus with a thick vertical trunk and two upward-curving arms, ribbed vertical lines, and one small pink flower on top of the trunk.
cards.hero_colors: green, dark green, pink flower

cards.name: Covered Wagon
cards.subject: A covered wagon with a wooden box body, four spoked wooden wheels with the rear pair larger, a rounded white canvas cover stretched over curved ribs, and a wooden tongue at the front resting on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: cream white, wood brown, red band at the canvas opening

cards.name: Hand Pump
cards.subject: A cast-iron hand water pump with a round base, a tall body, a curved spout and a long lever handle on top, with a small wooden trough below the spout, both standing on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: dark grey iron, wood brown trough, red lever handle

cards.name: Campfire
cards.subject: A bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it; a black enamel coffee pot with a spout and handle rests on a flat stone beside the logs.
cards.hero_colors: orange, yellow, wood brown, black pot, small blue speckles on the pot

cards.name: Lasso
cards.subject: A lasso: a coiled tan rope ending in a wide open loop with a sliding knot through a small brass ring.
cards.hero_colors: tan, brass ring

cards.name: Horseshoe
cards.subject: An iron horseshoe in a symmetrical U shape with the open end up, seven nail holes along the arms, and copper nail heads in the holes.
cards.hero_colors: silver grey iron, copper nail heads

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A cream white cowboy hat with a wide curled brim that rolls up at both sides, a tall crown with a center crease, and a band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: cream white, light grey, turquoise band

cards.name: Boots
cards.subject: A pair of red-brown leather cowboy boots with tall shafts, pointed toes and raised heels, standing side by side, with yellow stitching in a zigzag pattern on each shaft.
cards.hero_colors: red-brown, dark brown, yellow stitching

cards.name: Sheriff Badge
cards.subject: A symmetrical silver sheriff badge lying flat: a five-pointed star with a small ball on each point, a gold circle in the center, and a pin clasp at the back edge.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, gold center circle

cards.name: Saloon Doors
cards.subject: A pair of wooden swinging saloon doors with slatted louvers, each attached by hinges to a wooden frame, with a small lantern shaped icon cut in the top of the frame, set in a plank storefront entrance.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, tan, small green painted trim
cards.surface_or_setting: the entrance of a wooden saloon front on a plank porch

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A single tall green saguaro cactus with a thick vertical trunk and two upward-curving arms, ribbed vertical lines, and one small yellow flower on top of the trunk.
cards.hero_colors: green, dark green, yellow flower

cards.name: Tumbleweed
cards.subject: A tumbleweed: a round, symmetrical ball of tangled dry brown twigs with a few tiny green sprigs.
cards.hero_colors: dry brown, tan, small green sprigs

cards.name: Canteen
cards.subject: A round flat canteen with an olive green canvas cover, a short neck with a light brown cork stopper, and a brown leather strap stitched to both sides of the neck in a loop, with orange stitching around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: olive green, brown, light brown cork, orange stitching

cards.name: Barrel
cards.subject: A wooden barrel with bulging sides, vertical planks held by three dark iron hoops, a flat top, and a small cow-face pictogram branded in dark brown on the front.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, dark iron grey hoops, dark brown cow brand

cards.name: Harmonica
cards.subject: A silver harmonica: a long rectangular metal body with a row of ten small holes along the front and curved end covers on both sides.
cards.hero_colors: silver, grey, red end covers

cards.name: Hitching Post
cards.subject: A hitching post: two thick wooden posts planted upright in the ground, joined by one thick horizontal crossbeam nailed across both near the top, with a grey iron horseshoe nailed to the left post.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, grey horseshoe, small orange nail heads
cards.surface_or_setting: a dry dirt road edge in front of a wooden storefront

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A dark chocolate brown cowboy hat with a wide curled brim that rolls up at both sides, a tall crown with a center crease, and a thin leather band with a gold buckle at the front.
cards.hero_colors: chocolate brown, dark brown, gold buckle

cards.name: Boots
cards.subject: A pair of tan leather cowboy boots with tall shafts, pointed toes and raised heels, standing side by side, with orange stitching on each shaft.
cards.hero_colors: tan, brown, orange stitching

cards.name: Jail Door
cards.subject: A heavy wooden plank door in a wooden frame with iron hinges on one side and a round iron handle, with a silver six-pointed star badge with ball tips fastened flat to the door at eye level.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, silver star, gold ball tips
cards.surface_or_setting: a wooden storefront wall with a plank step

cards.name: Saloon Doors
cards.subject: A pair of wooden swinging saloon doors with slatted louvers, each attached by hinges to a wooden frame, set in a plank storefront entrance with a small step.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, tan, small red painted trim
cards.surface_or_setting: the entrance of a wooden saloon front on a plank porch

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A single tall green saguaro cactus with a thick vertical trunk and two upward-curving arms, ribbed vertical lines, and one small pink flower on top of the trunk.
cards.hero_colors: green, dark green, pink flower

cards.name: Saddle
cards.subject: A brown leather western saddle with a raised front horn, a high back, a wide seat, two long side flaps and two silver stirrups fastened to the sides, with a girth strap attached under the seat.
cards.hero_colors: leather brown, dark brown, silver stirrups

cards.name: Horse
cards.subject: A standing brown horse seen from the side with four legs, a dark mane and tail, a long neck and a white blaze on the face.
cards.hero_colors: chestnut brown, black mane, white blaze

cards.name: Guitar
cards.subject: An acoustic guitar lying flat seen from above, with a figure-eight body, a round sound hole, a long neck with six tuning pegs on a head, and six strings.
cards.hero_colors: honey wood, dark brown neck, turquoise ring around the sound hole

cards.name: Campfire
cards.subject: A bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it; a black enamel coffee pot with a spout and handle rests on a flat stone beside the logs.
cards.hero_colors: orange, yellow, wood brown, black pot, small blue speckles on the pot

cards.name: Bandana
cards.subject: A triangular red bandana cloth with three corners, shown flat with a small yellow dot pattern and a folded hem along the long edge.
cards.hero_colors: red, small yellow dots
